newsitem.title: USA: North Sea paper Brent gains in U.S. late trading.
newsitem.headline: North Sea paper Brent gains in U.S. late trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent paper cargoes fetched stronger prices in late U.S. aftermarket trading on Monday, boosting July values around 10 cents a barrel.
Traders said July Brent moved for a full cargo at $20.27 a barrel, 10 cents firmer than the IPE settlement price at $20.17 a barrel.
A separate cargo of July paper Brent sold at $20.26. Both cargoes were bought by a noted U.S. Wall Street firm.
A pair of partial deals saw July Brent trade 200 times at $20.25 and a slim 50 lots at $20.22, traders said.
